preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Victim user must hold some SHF tokens in their wallet

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the multiTransfer function specifying the victim's address as the 'from' parameter and your address as one of the recipients. This will transfer the victim's SHF tokens to your wallet without requiring their approval, exploiting the authorized privilege to initiate transfers from arbitrary addresses.
